name: NORDCAN 2.0
owner_name: International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC/WHO) and Association of Nordic Cancer Registries (ANCR)
description: NORDCAN 2.0 presents cancer statistics (incidence, mortality, prevalence and survival) for the Nordic countries: Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, Sweden, the Faroe Islands, Greenland and Aland. Developed by the IARC Section of Cancer Surveillance with the Association of Nordic Cancer Registries on Global Cancer Observatory technology.
